notes: M3 'is August the odd one out?' test (created 2026-11-07). Event = S1D 2026-06-30; reference = Sentinel-1A dry-season median, 6, 18 and 30 Jan 2026 (11 Feb excluded: 108 mm rain), same lane 95 descending. A twin-satellite offset (S12) affects the flood and the control run equally, so compare the two runs, not absolute values.
